overview: The Traffic Commission approved several parking regulations, crosswalk designations, and individual permit parking variances across Medford, and accepted opt-out petitions from several streets near the Green Line Extension. The commission also voted to table a broader proposal expanding residential permit parking in the South Medford and Hillside neighborhoods until its next meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the November meeting.

items.title: 2022-61: Morton Avenue Parking Restrictions
items.summary: Approved three-hour parking from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. and permit-only parking from 10:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m., excluding Sundays and holidays, on the north side of Morton Avenue along Tufts Park.

items.title: Tufts Park Parking Lot Regulations
items.summary: Approved three-hour parking from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. with no overnight restrictions and allowed business permit parking in the Tufts Park municipal lot off Morton Avenue.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance: Wellington Road
items.summary: Approved a resident parking permit variance for a resident abutting both Fellsway and Wellington Road to park on Wellington Road.

items.title: 2022-68: Boston Avenue Crosswalk at Dowling Hall
items.summary: Approved permanently establishing a crosswalk on Boston Avenue aligned with the Tufts University Dowling Hall entrance.

items.title: 2022-64: Grant Avenue Permit Parking
items.summary: Approved resident permit parking 24/7 on Grant Avenue from Salem Street to Hooker Street starting after the commercial corner, coupled with a request for the city to install wayfinding signage to the nearby municipal parking lot.

items.title: 2022-65: Parking Variance for 402 Main Street
items.summary: Approved a one-year parking permit variance allowing a Main Street resident without a driveway to park on Wareham Street.

items.title: 2022-67: Main Street Crosswalk at Columbia Road and Royal Street
items.summary: Approved installing a new crosswalk across Main Street at the northern leg of the Columbia Road and Royal Street intersection.

items.title: 2022-57: Parking Variance for Woodbine Road
items.summary: Approved a parking permit variance allowing a College Avenue resident without off-street parking to park on Woodbine Road.

items.title: 2022-66: Green Line Extension Neighborhood Opt-Out Petitions
items.summary: Approved opt-out petitions exempting several streets and street segments—including West Street, Cotting Street, Winter Street, Lyman Avenue, and portions of Auburn Street, North Street, Walkling Court, and Marshall Street—from proposed Green Line Extension residential permit parking.

items.title: 2022-49: Expansion of Pilot Residential Permit Parking
items.summary: Tabled a proposal to expand the residential permit parking pilot across unrestricted public streets in South Medford and Hillside until the next meeting to gather more data and feedback.

items.title: Recognition of Commissioner Pesaturo
items.summary: Commissioners recognized and thanked outgoing Commissioner Ann Marie Pesaturo for her service as her term comes to an end.
